lines.text: Photos: the Look and Profile tiles and the zoom map show the photo again (they were blank).
Photos: a JPEG exported with no edits is exactly the original again, with no rounding noise added.
Photos: curves look the same on screen as in the exported file, and pasting on many photos keeps the open one whole.
Photos: edit backups in Drive are never taken in as photos, so deleting one can no longer trash a backup.
